verdict.rationale: Omnara is open source under Apache 2.0 and free to self-host. Self-hosted deployments keep agent history in Postgres, where it can be queried directly. Agents are defined as YAML configs, and a documented REST API with an OpenAPI spec offers programmatic access, so data can be retrieved and moved, but only through self-hosting or the API rather than a dedicated export. Missing for 10: a documented one-click or bulk export for hosted (cloud) accounts, explicit export formats covering all data (conversations, attachments, skills, settings), migration/offboarding docs, and independent hands-on confirmation of a full export.
